distinguishingMotifs: Compact raised hexagonal/radial core with several low market wings/aisles, rather than a single giant shop.
Warm exposed red-brick piers and walls are broken by pale gray concrete/stone lintels and trim.
A higher rear/core volume has a shaped pale parapet and small upper windows; the hexagonal identity is primarily the plan, not permission to invent a pointed roof.
Broad dark open entry bays connect to market aisles; subtle pale blue-green awning glass can mark the entrance.
Low tiled forecourt,pottedgreenery and a few stall-edge details give a lived-in local market scale.
